description: Container logs from any stack: keep a fixed set of top-level fields and move everything else (parsed app JSON) into the flat_object 'fields'. Prevents mapping explosion and type conflicts that would make the shipper retry a chunk forever.

script.description: containers-<stack>-<env>-<date>: fill stack/env when the shipper did not send them
script.source: String i = ctx._index; if (i.startsWith('containers-')) { String[] p = i.substring(11).splitOnToken('-'); if (p.length >= 3) { if (ctx.stack == null) { ctx.stack = p[0]; } if (ctx.env == null) { ctx.env = p[1]; } } }

script.description: Docker's fluentd driver sends container_name as '/name'

script.source: Map extra = ctx.containsKey('fields') && ctx.fields instanceof Map ? ctx.fields : new HashMap(); List move = new ArrayList(); for (String k : ctx.keySet()) { if (!k.startsWith('_') && !params.core.contains(k)) { move.add(k); } } for (String k : move) { extra.put(k, ctx.remove(k)); } if (!extra.isEmpty()) { ctx.fields = extra; } if (ctx.level != null && !(ctx.level instanceof String)) { ctx.level = String.valueOf(ctx.level); } if (ctx.message != null && !(ctx.message instanceof String)) { ctx.message = String.valueOf(ctx.message); } if (ctx.message == null && ctx.log instanceof String) { ctx.message = ctx.log; } if (ctx.log != null && ctx.message != null && ctx.log == ctx.message) { ctx.remove('log'); }
